new_results.statement: If A is symmetric with at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least one, then after splitting full third-compound mass by overlap q=0,1,2,3, one can select disjoint original-coordinate banks carrying respectively one of the dimension-free packet lower bounds 1/5184, 1/3125, 1/512, 1/18. The exact coloring probabilities before the E_q>=1/4 choice are 1/1296, 4/3125, 1/128, 2/9.
For physical pair H with invertible principal block B_H, W_H^(2)=det(B_H)^2 ||S_H||_F^2, and sum_H W_H^(2)=E_2+3E_3. Under s_3(A)>=1, ||S_H||_op>=1.

Using the completed sharp scalar product-projection cap and the prior quarter-root square transducer, if F=d(X+m)^2+H and H has a zero-self physical row of off-diagonal norm eta, then H_{1/2}(F)<=2^(27/8)(|d|eta)^(-1/4)<10.375(|d|eta)^(-1/4); also ||p_F||_infinity<=2^(11/4)(|d|eta)^(-1/2).

partner_result_applied.application: Sharp rearrangement/product-projection input, with the explicit general scalar projection cap also recorded by account02/B04, was inserted into the zero-self inner-Schur half-Riesz inequality and then into the prior B07 square transducer.
